title: Structural basis for pharmacotherapeutic action of triple reuptake inhibitors
core_idea: Determine structural ensembles of the dopamine transporter bound to multiple triple reuptake inhibitors to map inhibitor binding sites and transporter conformations, providing a blueprint to inform design of more effective antidepressants.
tldr: Use structural characterization of DAT–inhibitor complexes to understand inhibitor association and transporter conformations, guiding development of potent triple reuptake inhibitor antidepressants.
